entries: The warforged titan makes one axehand attack and one hammerfist attack.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}19 ({@dégât 3d8 + 6}) slashingdgts, plus 11 ({@dégât 2d10}) slashingdgts if la cible is {@condition à terre}.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}19 ({@dégât 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoningdgts. If la cible is une créature, it doit réussir on a {@dd 17}Force saving throw or be knocked {@condition à terre}.

action.name: Sweeping Axe {@recharge}
entries: The warforged titan makes a sweep with its axehand, and each creature within 10 mètres of it doit faire a {@dd 17}Dextérité saving throw. A creature takes 19 ({@dégât 3d8 + 6}) slashingdgts on a failed save, or half as muchdgts on a successful one.

vulnerable.note: from magic weapons wielded by good creatures

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The rakshasa's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 11}). The rakshasa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Immunité magique limitée
entries: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 1st level or lower unless it wishes to be. It avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Armes magiques
entries: The rakshasa's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Martial Prowess (1/Turn)
entries: When the rakshasatouchés une créature with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 11 ({@dice 2d10})dgts of the weapon's type, and la créature doit faire a {@dd 15}Force saving throw. On a failure, the rakshasa can push la créature up to 10 mètres away from it, knock la créature {@condition à terre}, or make la créature drop one item it is holding of the rakshasa's choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes three melee weapon attacks. Alternatively, it can make two ranged attacks with its javelins.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}8 ({@dégât 1d8 + 4}) slashingdgts, or 9 ({@dégât 1d10 + 4}) slashingdgts if used with two hands.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 5 m, or portée 30/120 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d6 + 4}) piercingdgts.
